# Al Jazeera
> Global news organization covering breaking news, analysis, video, features, opinion, and multimedia journalism from the Middle East and around the world.

Al Jazeera publishes international reporting across regional news desks, thematic coverage areas, live blogs, video, documentaries, interactives, photo essays, and podcasts, with strong emphasis on geopolitics, human rights, conflict, climate, and underreported stories.

## Main News Hubs
- [Home](https://www.aljazeera.com/): Homepage with breaking news, top stories, live coverage, and featured multimedia journalism.
- [News](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/): Main news index for latest global reporting, live updates, and developing stories.
- [Middle East](https://www.aljazeera.com/middle-east/): Regional coverage of politics, conflict, diplomacy, and society across the Middle East.
- [Africa](https://www.aljazeera.com/africa/): News and analysis from across Africa, including politics, conflict, and development.
- [Asia](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia/): Coverage of South, East, and Southeast Asia with breaking news and analysis.
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia-pacific/): Reporting focused on East Asia, Oceania, and wider Pacific regional developments.
- [Europe](https://www.aljazeera.com/europe/): European news coverage spanning politics, war, migration, and economic developments.
- [US & Canada](https://www.aljazeera.com/us-canada/): North America coverage including US politics, Canada, and regional policy issues.
- [Latin America](https://www.aljazeera.com/latin-america/): News and features from Latin America on politics, society, and regional affairs.

## Topics and Coverage Areas
- [Economy](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/): Global economy, markets, trade, energy, and business reporting.
- [Climate Crisis](https://www.aljazeera.com/climate-crisis): Coverage of climate change, environmental policy, disasters, and adaptation.
- [Human Rights](https://www.aljazeera.com/tag/human-rights/): Tagged coverage of human rights issues, abuses, advocacy, and international law.
- [Science & Technology](https://www.aljazeera.com/tag/science-and-technology/): Reporting on science, technology, innovation, and digital policy topics.
- [Explained](https://www.aljazeera.com/tag/explainer/): Explainer articles that break down complex events, conflicts, and policy issues.
- [Investigations](https://www.aljazeera.com/investigations/): Investigative journalism and in-depth reporting on corruption, abuse, and hidden systems.
- [Features](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/): Long-form feature stories, profiles, and narrative reporting from around the world.
- [Opinion](https://www.aljazeera.com/opinion/): Commentary and analysis from columnists, contributors, and guest writers.

## Multimedia
- [Video](https://www.aljazeera.com/videos/): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and clips from Al Jazeera programming.
- [In Pictures](https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/): Photo essays and image galleries documenting major events and daily life.
- [Interactives](https://www.aljazeera.com/interactives/): Data-driven visual stories, maps, timelines, and interactive explainers.
- [Sport](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/): Sports news, analysis, tournaments, and athlete-focused reporting.
- [Documentaries](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/featured-documentaries/): Featured documentary films and long-form visual storytelling.
- [Shows](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/): Program hub for Al Jazeera shows, series, and broadcast segments.

## Live and Streaming
- [Live](https://www.aljazeera.com/live/): Live page for streaming news coverage and current broadcast programming.
- [Live Broadcast](https://www.aljazeera.com/live/): Watch Al Jazeera’s live television news stream online.
- [Live Blog Coverage](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/): Index of live blogs covering wars, elections, crises, and breaking events.
- [Schedule](https://www.aljazeera.com/schedule/): Broadcast schedule for Al Jazeera programming and live news shows.

## Audio and Podcasts
- [Podcasts](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/): Podcast directory featuring news, interviews, and documentary audio series.
- [The Take](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-take): Daily news podcast explaining one major story shaping the world.
- [The Inside Story Podcast](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-inside-story-podcast): Audio version of the current affairs discussion program.
- [Hindsight](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/hindsight): Narrative history podcast revisiting major events and influential figures.
- [Centre Stage](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/centre-stage): Interview podcast featuring conversations with prominent global voices.
- [True Crime Reports](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/true-crime-reports): Investigative true crime podcast focused on global stories and justice.
- [Listen Live](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/live): Live audio stream from Al Jazeera.

## Programs and Series
- [Inside Story](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/inside-story/): Discussion program analyzing major international news developments.
- [Fault Lines](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/fault-lines/): Investigative documentary series focused on US and global issues.
- [People & Power](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/people-power/): Investigative series examining power, accountability, and social justice.
- [101 East](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/101-east/): Documentary series reporting from across Asia and the Pacific.
- [Witness](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/witness/): Short documentaries telling personal stories from around the world.
- [Talk to Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/talk-to-al-jazeera/): Long-form interviews with political, cultural, and intellectual figures.
- [UpFront](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/upfront/): Interview and debate show on politics, policy, and global affairs.
- [The Stream](https://www.aljazeera.com/program/the-stream/): Social media-driven discussion show on global issues and communities.

## Special Formats
- [Long Reads](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/): In-depth written features and narrative journalism on major global topics.
- [Explainers](https://www.aljazeera.com/tag/explainer/): Accessible backgrounders on conflicts, elections, and policy developments.
- [Photo Essays](https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/): Visual storytelling through curated image collections and captions.
- [Investigative Reports](https://www.aljazeera.com/investigations/): Deep reporting projects uncovering systemic wrongdoing and hidden networks.
- [Interactive Features](https://www.aljazeera.com/interactives/): Visual and data-led storytelling for complex international issues.

## Utility and Access
- [Search](https://www.aljazeera.com/search/): Search across articles, videos, programs, and topic pages.
- [Authors](https://www.aljazeera.com/author/): Author pages for reporters, correspondents, and contributors.
- [Tags](https://www.aljazeera.com/tag/): Topic tag index for subject-based browsing across coverage.
- [Articles Generated by Automated Voice](https://www.aljazeera.com/articles-generated-by-automated-voice): Accessibility page for articles available with automated voice narration.
